title: 第十一章 绝路
content_zh:
天没亮透，沈家的人就来了。

    江砚是被一阵杂沓的脚步声惊醒的。他一夜没怎么合眼，靠着冰冷的土墙坐到天光将白，浑身的旧伤被冻得发木。院门“哐“地被人一脚踹开，几条黑影涌进来，当头的，是沈贵。

    沈贵是城里富户沈家的管事，平日里收租要债，那张油光满面的脸是江砚最熟也最怕的。可今天，他脸上没了往日那种皮笑肉不笑的客气，只剩一片冷硬。

    “人呢？就是这小子？“沈贵下巴一抬。

    跟在他身后的，是两个膀大腰圆的家丁，还有——江狗剩。

    江砚的心，“咯噔“一声往下沉。

    他看见江狗剩缩在沈贵身后，眼神躲躲闪闪，不敢跟他对视。可那躲闪里头，又藏着一丝说不出的得意和慌乱。

    “就是他。“江狗剩的声音又尖又急，“沈管事，我亲眼瞧见的，他半夜摸进沈家的粮囤，偷了好大一袋子粮！我喊他，他还拿石头砸我——“

    “放屁！“江砚猛地站起来，一股血气直冲脑门，“我昨晚一步没出过这院子！你血口喷人！“

    “哟，还嘴硬。“沈贵慢悠悠开口，一只手抚着腰间那块油亮的牌子，“江砚，你也别喊冤。沈家的粮囤昨夜确实少了一袋。狗剩是人证，囤边的脚印是物证——“他顿了顿，眼皮一掀，“你那双破草鞋，前头烂了个口子，是不是？囤边那脚印，前头也缺一块。“

    江砚浑身一凉。

    他低头看自己的鞋。右脚那只草鞋的鞋头，确实烂了，露着冻得发紫的脚趾。

    这是栽赃。是早就备好的局。

    他一下子全明白了。沈家觊觎沈家村这几亩薄田不是一天两天了，村里几户人家的地都被沈贵用各种由头一点点啃了去。江家就剩他这么个无父无母、没人撑腰的孤儿，是这局里最好拿捏的一个软柿子。偷粮是假，要他这条命、要江家那点田契才是真。

    “我没偷。“江砚咬着牙，一个字一个字地往外蹦，“你们要田，明说。何苦栽我一个偷字。“

    这话一出，沈贵脸上那点假面具彻底撕了。

    “识相。“他冷笑一声，“既然你晓得了，那就好办。江砚，你偷了沈家的粮，按大胤律，主家有权扭你见官。可念你年纪小，沈家慈悲——你把江家那几亩地的田契交出来，抵了这桩偷盗，这事，就算了。“

    “地是我爹娘留下的。“江砚听见自己的声音在抖，不是怕，是气，“不交。“

    “不交？“

    沈贵脸一沉，朝两个家丁使了个眼色。

    “那就别怪沈家不讲情面。偷盗主家粮米,按律——杖责、发卖为奴。捆了，明日一早送青石镇官府发卖！“

    “你们——“
content_en:
Before dawn, the Shen family members arrived.

    Jiang Yan was awakened by the sound of clattering footsteps. He didn't sleep much all night, sitting against the cold earth wall until the sky was almost white, and the old wounds all over his body were numb from the cold. The courtyard door was kicked open with a bang, and several black figures rushed in. The one at the head was Shen Gui.

    Shen Gui is the steward of the Shen family, a wealthy family in the city. He collects rent and debts on weekdays. His shiny face is what Jiang Yan is most familiar with and most afraid of. But today, his face no longer had the smiley politeness of the past, only a cold look remained on his face.

    "Where's the man? Is this the boy?" Shen Gui raised his chin.

    Behind him were two big and round servants, and Jiang Goucheng.

    Jiang Yan's heart sank with a thud.

    He saw Jiang Gouchen huddled behind Shen Gui, his eyes evasive, not daring to look at him. But there was a trace of unspeakable pride and panic hidden in that dodge.

    "That's him." Jiang Goucheng's voice was high-pitched and urgent, "Manager Shen, I saw it with my own eyes. He broke into the Shen family's grain store in the middle of the night and stole a big bag of grain! I called him, and he hit me with a stone - "

    "Fart!" Jiang Yan stood up suddenly, a burst of blood rushing to his forehead, "I never left this yard last night! You are spitting blood!"

    "Oh, talk back." Shen Gui spoke slowly, stroking the shiny sign on his waist with one hand, "Jiang Yan, don't complain. The Shen family's grain hoard did lack a bag last night. The leftover dog is a witness, and the footprints next to the hoard are physical evidence -" He paused and raised his eyelids, "Your pair of broken straw sandals has a hole in the front, right? The footprints next to the hoard are also missing a piece of the front."

    Jiang Yan felt cold all over.

    He looked down at his shoes. The toe of the straw sandal on my right foot was indeed rotten, and the toes were exposed and turned purple from the cold.

    This is framed. It's a game that has been prepared a long time ago.

    He understood it all at once. The Shen family has been coveting the few acres of thin farmland in Shenjia Village for more than a day or two. The land of several families in the village has been nibbled away by Shen Gui for various reasons. He is the only orphan left in the Jiang family who has no father, no mother, and no one to support him. He is the best weakling in this game. Stealing food is a lie, but taking his life and the Jiang family's land deed is real.

    "I didn't steal." Jiang Yan gritted his teeth and spoke out word by word, "You want the land, so say it clearly. Why bother to accuse me of stealing."

    As soon as these words came out, the mask on Shen Gui's face was completely torn off.

    "Knowing the truth." He sneered, "Since you know, it's easy to handle. Jiang Yan, you stole the food of the Shen family. According to the laws of Dayin, the master has the right to force you to see the official. But because you are young, the Shen family is merciful - you hand over the land deeds of the Jiang family's several acres of land to pay for the theft. Let's forget about it."

    "The land was left by my parents." Jiang Yan heard his voice trembling, not out of fear, but out of anger, "No."

    "Don't pay?"

    Shen Gui's face sank and he winked at the two servants.

    "Then don't blame the Shen family for being unkind. Stealing the master's grain and rice will, according to the law, be punished with a rod and sold into slavery. Tie them up and send them to the Qingshi Town government for sale early tomorrow morning!"

    "You-"
